patterns: APPSC asks author-work one-liners: Pavuluri Mallana = Ganita Sara Sangraha, Ketana = Abhinava Dandi (Dasakumara Charitra), Jayapa = Gaja-Sahini, Nannechoda = Kumarasambhavam.
Statement-type items on Nannaya (Andhra Mahabharatam, Andhra Shabda Chintamani, Nandampudi agrahara) with keys sometimes differing from textbook versions.
Not-correctly-matched pairs among Shiva Kavis (Palkuriki - Panditaradhya Charitra / Basava Puranam) are a recurring trap.
UPSC/other PSC items cover epic versions in other languages (Pampa - Kannada); APPSC stays on Telugu poets and Kakatiya-court authors.
App MCQs include meta items about 'sources' and 'keys' and very fine inscription trivia that no PYQ reaches.
